name: Fever
description: A heat behind the eyes that comes and goes. You are not certain which of your thoughts are yours.
remedyNote: Rest may break it; a healer is safer.
onset: By evening your face is hot and your hands are cold.
daily: The fever comes and goes; the day is spent in small, careful errands.
recovery: The heat behind your eyes is gone, and the world is merely itself again.

provenance.notes: A period-plausible travel fever, not a specific disease claim.
